From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP milestone: legal edits playbook & owner commitments

Hi Emma / SummitPay legal team —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward the end-of-quarter close:

- Action: Legal redline review (MSA + DPA + SLA) — we expect limited edits based on today's scope conversation.
- Owner (SummitPay): review + initial redlines
- Owner (Redwood): intake + routing to our legal / security team and a counter-redline turnaround target
- Target close date: May 10, 2028 (customer PO by signing)
- Dependencies: SSO config details, data residency confirmation, SOC2 evidence packet (we can provide)

I've attached a draft MAP sheet with a proposed milestone row for the legal redline stage and a short playbook for how edits will be routed. Please review and add any missing dependencies or alternate owners.

Proposed turnaround commitments (Redwood side):
- Acknowledge receipt of redlines within 24 business hours
- Internal intake + legal analysis and first-pass counter within 3 business days for standard edits
- Complex commercial changes may require a 7–10 business day review cycle and will be flagged in the MAP

If that cadence works for you, can SummitPay confirm who will be the single point of contact for legal and procurement redlines? Noted Emma as primary for procurement in the demo, but would like a legal SPOC.

Thanks — I’ll set up a short weekly MAP checkpoint (15 minutes) starting next Monday to track progress.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

Hi Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. We are the legal intake for SummitPay. We'll aim to deliver initial redlines by end of day Wednesday (2028-04-04). Two items to flag now:

1) Data residency: need written confirmation of where customer data will be processed for SummitPay production. Can Redwood confirm region/region-level controls?
2) SLA liability cap: our procurement will push for reciprocal liability language. Expect to propose a different cap; we'll include suggested alternative wording in the redline document.

We will upload a consolidated PDF with comments to the HubSpot deal thread and copy you. Confirming our SPOC: legal@summitpay.com (triage) and cc procurement for pricing/PO lane.

Thanks — this is helpful and expected. A couple notes to keep the MAP milestone clean and reduce back-and-forth: 

- Data residency: Redwood will provide formal confirmation. We host production clusters in us-west-2 and can provide region-specific processing statements and SOC2 evidence. Marissa, can your team attach the residency statement and SOC2 summary to the MAP by EOD Tuesday?
- SLA liability cap: understood. Our legal team will review SummitPay's suggested language and try to surface a commercially reasonable counter. For clarity in the MAP, I'm proposing this milestone row:

  Milestone: Legal redlines received + Redwood countered
  SummitPay owner: legal@summitpay.com
  Redwood owner: marissa_cole@redwood.com (Legal Ops)
  Target: redlines received 2028-04-04; Redwood counter 2028-04-07 (3 business days)
  Escalation: If there are material commercial changes (pricing or liability caps), escalate to Ben Carter + Sales Leadership for a quick decision play (48 hours)

- If SummitPay uploads the redlines to HubSpot, I'll mark the MAP row as 'awaiting redline' and trigger the intake workflow so our legal ops sees it immediately.

Emma — if procurement will need a separate procurement review row (PO terms), let me know so we can add that dependency and owner.

Ben

Thanks all — granular confirmation from my side: 

- I've attached the residency statement and SOC2 summary to the shared MAP (link above).
- Redwood commit for the MAP milestone timings is acceptable: acknowledge within 24 business hours; counter within 3 business days for standard redlines.
- Intake playbook (short):
  1) SummitPay uploads consolidated PDF to HubSpot
  2) Legal Ops triages and tags items as 'commercial' vs 'standard'
  3) Standard items -> draft counter (3 business days)
  4) Commercial items -> route to Sales (Ben) + Legal for decision (48-hour decision SLA recommended)

I can own the Redwood counter and will tag Tessa on any data/security clarifications. If SummitPay completes upload by Wednesday EOD, Redwood will post a counter by Friday EOD (2028-04-07).

Marissa Cole
